Why We Love Algae and Seaweed!

The many benefits of algaes and seaweeds are abundant. Offering a rich source of nutrients and antioxidants. They can help fight inflammation and damage to tissues caused by free radicals and are also rich in protein and amino acids that help the body to fight infections.These amazing earth wonders can also help assist our body with detoxification by removing toxins and heavy metals from the body.

Algaes and Seaweeds provide these benefits and so much more! That is why we love the health giving products below!

Chlorella:

LifeGive™ Chlorella is a single cell Green Algae. Chlorella has many benefits to assist in the achievement of optimal wellbeing including helping the body to get more out of vitamins and minerals, helping with blood sugar regulation, and detoxifying the body of heavy metals.

Chlorella is said to make you look younger by improving the appearance of your skin. The wonderful components of vitamin A, vitamin C, and glutathione can make your skin look younger and more vibrant while protecting your cells.

Studies have also shown chlorellas effects in reducing the appearance of spider veins by reducing the redness caused by the vascular imperfections. Additionally, extracts from chlorella may help improve the production of your skin's collagen, the primary protein responsible for elasticity while also assisting to rid the body of free-radicals that can cause damage.
